verdicts.reason: A reads left to right: the FIZZBANG! pill sits on the left and the SINCE 2026 badge on the right, both on one centre line. The pill's text is small for 320x50, though, and the badge is nearly as heavy as the headline, with dead halftone between them. B puts the brand pill in the top-right corner, nearly touching the top and right edges, and drops the badge to the bottom-left. That diagonal stagger looks accidental, reverses the reading order (the badge comes before the brand) and leaves the logo cramped.
